root_cause.description: The registered handler writes a private record without checking the fixture identity.

fix.description: Deny guest requests before invoking the private-record service.

decisions.rationale: The cross-package source warrants a runtime check, but neither a live HTTP request nor remediation is proven by static calls.

unresolved.claim: A real guest HTTP request must reach the registered handler.
An unchanged harness must observe denial after the authorization change.
